title: OpenAI推出Daybreak计划：10亿美元强化关键基础设施网络安全
summary: OpenAI正式发布Daybreak for Frontline Defenders计划，承诺投入10亿美元，旨在扩大前沿网络人工智能技术、培训及支持服务的覆盖面，以保护电力、水务、医疗、交通等关键基础设施和基本服务免受日益复杂的网络威胁。该计划将向一线防御者（包括网络安全专业人员、基础设施运营者及政府机构）提供先进的AI工具、威胁情报、自动化防御能力以及专业培训，帮助其提升检测、响应和恢复能力。Daybreak计划体现了AI技术在网络安全领域的深度应用，通过整合大语言模型、实时分析及自动化响应机制，增强对新兴攻击的预测与抵御能力。OpenAI强调，此举不仅是对技术资源的投入，更是对全球关键服务韧性的承诺，旨在构建一个更安全、更具适应性的数字生态。该计划预计将推动AI安全技术的标准化，并促进公私部门合作，为应对未来网络风险树立新范式。
summary_en: OpenAI has announced the Daybreak for Frontline Defenders initiative, committing $1 billion to expand access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services. The program aims to protect critical infrastructure such as power, water, healthcare, and transportation from sophisticated cyber threats by equipping frontline defenders with advanced AI tools, threat intelligence, and automated defense capabilities. This initiative underscores the growing role of AI in cybersecurity, leveraging large language models and real-time analytics to enhance threat prediction and response. OpenAI emphasizes that the investment goes beyond technology, fostering public-private collaboration and setting a new standard for resilience in the digital age.
